::: {#exm-data-generating-process}
#### A normal data-generating process

<!-- no-figure: the example only fixes a distribution and its parameters -->

Let $\dsn{X}$ be [IID](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/independence.html#def-iid) [normal](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-normal) random variables
with [expectation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-expectation) $\mean = 0$ and [variance](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-variance) $\varpar = 4$,
with $n = 10$.
The distribution of these variables is a [data-generating process](#def-data-generating-process),
and the [estimand](estimation.qmd#def-estimand) $\varpar = 4$ is known exactly,
so the error of any [estimator](estimation.qmd#def-estimator) of $\varpar$ can be computed.
:::
